materials.note: The snapshot confirms only that programming assignments and a project exist; it does not supply their contents.

blocked.reason: Only an external index URL was supplied; its current contents, access terms, and unit structure were not inspected.
Recordings are described as semester-dependent, but no recording URLs or files were supplied.
No individual lecture note, slide deck, textbook, or paper was identified.
No assignment statement, project specification, or semester mapping was supplied.

rules: Do not infer lecture, reading, assignment, or project contents from a catalog description.
Do not fetch content requiring authentication, enrollment, payment, bypassed controls, or uncertain authorization.
A later authorized job may inspect public locators, but must record the final URL, retrieval outcome, semester, license or access terms, and a content digest.
Validate resource identity and dependencies before promoting any retrieved record to an official course unit.
Keep unavailable or failed retrievals explicit; never replace them with fabricated material.
retrieval_policy.future_expansion_gate: Later course expansion requires durable retrieval evidence and validator-controlled classification; a prose claim or live link alone is insufficient.
